meta.name: The Munchkin Paradox Grimoire
meta.description: An arcane tome detailing the Paradox Symposium of St. Munchkin. A secret order of subterranean bureaucrats, sommeliers, and stray-cat whisperers who exploit hilarious literal loopholes. In this grimoire, they discovered that using a quill to write a ledger of overkill damage on Flint Shale will cause the rock to spontaneously shatter nearby blocks to balance the accounting. Works best when the author is fully rested.
meta.author: jules:session
